themes_detail.label: Street Sweeping Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints spiked to 8 complaints THIS WEEK, up 814% from the 0.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.76), suggesting a sudden operational failure or service withdrawal in Flatbush/PLG.
evidence: 8 street sweeping complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly baseline (814% spike)
Z-score of 6.76 indicates statistically significant anomaly
No comparable spike in prior 8-week period
reporting_angles: Contact Sanitation Department about service disruptions or staffing changes in CD 309 this week
Interview residents on specific blocks affected; identify if complaints cluster geographically

themes_detail.label: Graffiti Surge
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints jumped to 22 last week, up 577% from the 3.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.43), signaling either a coordinated tagging campaign or delayed removal in Flatbush/PLG.
evidence: 22 graffiti complaints last week vs. 3.2 weekly baseline (577% increase)
Z-score of 5.43 indicates highly significant statistical anomaly
No prior week in 8-week window showed comparable spike
reporting_angles: Map complaint locations to identify if graffiti is concentrated on specific corridors or neighborhoods
Interview Parks/Sanitation about removal capacity and timeline for response

themes_detail.label: Water System Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Water system complaints peaked at 39 two weeks ago, up 366% from the 8.4 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.74), indicating potential infrastructure failures or service disruptions affecting multiple addresses.
evidence: 39 water system complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 8.4 weekly baseline (366% spike)
Z-score of 5.74 indicates severe statistical anomaly
Combined with 460 water leak complaints and 616 plumbing complaints (90-day totals) suggests systemic strain
reporting_angles: Contact DEP about main breaks, pressure drops, or emergency work in Flatbush/PLG area 2 weeks ago
Interview residents who filed complaints; identify geographic pattern of outages or low pressure

themes_detail.label: Elevator Outages Spike
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints jumped to 24 two weeks ago, up 205% from the 7.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.66), affecting multifamily residents, seniors, and people with mobility challenges in aging housing stock.
evidence: 24 elevator complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 7.9 weekly baseline (205% increase)
Z-score of 5.66 indicates highly significant anomaly
Flatbush/PLG has substantial aging multifamily stock, creating vulnerable population impact
reporting_angles: Interview residents in affected buildings about repair timelines and impact on elderly or disabled residents
Investigate whether complaints cluster in particular buildings or landlords with deferred maintenance

themes_detail.label: Abandoned Vehicle Spike
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned vehicle complaints spiked to 17 two weeks ago, up 325% from the 4.0 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.63), suggesting a surge in vehicle dumping or towing backlog in Flatbush/PLG.
evidence: 17 abandoned vehicle complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 4.0 weekly baseline (325% spike)
Z-score of 11.63 is the highest severity anomaly in the dataset
Baseline abandonment rate suggests this is not a chronic problem, but a recent surge
reporting_angles: Identify if abandoned vehicles cluster on specific blocks or near transit hubs
Check with NYPD and DSNY about towing capacity and whether removal backlog contributed to spike
